steps.name: A Mysterious Building Facing the Sky
steps.objective: Visit the "Sky Castle" and find out what happened. Then report to [Arcane] at the "Oscuras Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Hm? What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's ask about the building behind him.)

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: This? It's a peculiar building I've been investigating.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Inside, there's a stairway leading up toward the ceiling. At the very top stands an enormous stone door that won't open.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Even with every member of the company lending a hand, we couldn't open it or break it down.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Judging by the building's shape from outside, there should be nothing beyond that door. That's what Pikman said. ...But my gut tells me there's definitely something on the other side.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Ha ha. You look like you don't believe me. That's fine. I'm just doing what I want to do.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Why don't you go inside and climb up yourself? You probably won't find anything special, but the view from up there isn't bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Arcane finishes speaking with a low chuckle. ...Should I go inside and take a look upstairs?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stone door rattles with a faint tremor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A faint sound seems to come from the other side of the door.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like the door will open. Should I go in?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? That familiar little face beneath a golden helmet with wings...?!)
(Grrrr...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's definitely an animal's growl mixed in with that heavy breathing.)
...A human...? How did you get in?
...The scent of a wolf... ...You carry Jeril's scent...

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: My name is Hawa. I am the master of this Sky Castle.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Human... what are you...? What connection do you have to Jeril...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: His friend?

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: That foul-tempered white wolf's...?

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: You're friends with that foul-tempered, rotten white wolf?!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: ...A friend of Jeril's is an enemy of mine.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: I'll make you regret ever meeting that white wolf!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hawa and Jeril don't seem to get along very well.)

choices.text: 2. I'm the human who defeated Jeril!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: You defeated Jeril?!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Don't lie!!! That white wolf may be foul-tempered and rotten, but his strength is beyond question!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Jeril would never fall to a mere human!!!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: You dare tarnish Jeril's honor with such a lie... I won't forgive you. I'll make you regret it!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't tell whether he likes Jeril or hates him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...If it was going to make him this angry, why did he ask about Jeril in the first place?)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: ...You're quite strong, human. What is your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hawa's voice comes from behind the door. I tell him my name.)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: ......You remind me of the humans who once lived here.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: They were strong, shining with conviction... There was a mysterious air about them.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: I dislike humans. Whenever they see me, they scream and draw their swords. But those humans weren't so bad.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: We used to play together often. Sparring...? That's what they called it.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: I'd forgotten them so completely that I can't even remember when they stopped coming. But today...

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Today, I feel the way I did back then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could the humans Hawa is talking about be...?)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Come back whenever you like, human. No... %s.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Let's play again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hawa's presence fades away.)

translation.method: Fresh translation from the current Korean source
